title: DataTab error and panic report, schema 1
description: The only fields a diagnostic report may carry (ADR 0008). A field not named here is never sent, and the server rejects a body that adds one.

schema.description: Document version. The server accepts 1 and nothing else.

report_id.description: Random UUID v4, new for every report. Never the audit correlation id.

app_version.description: The workspace version the binary was built from.

os.description: Operating system family, as std::env::consts::OS names it.

os_version.description: Human OS release name, when the platform tells us one.

arch.description: CPU architecture, as std::env::consts::ARCH names it.

created_hour.description: UTC time rounded down to the hour.

error_kind.description: ErrorKind of a user-facing error. Absent on a panic.

severity.description: EventSeverity of a user-facing error. Absent on a panic.

driver_id.description: A built-in driver id, or rpc for any external driver. Never rpc:<socket_id>.

error_code.description: Driver or error code, if it is a short closed token.

panic_message.description: A &'static str panic payload after scrubbing, or <dropped: N chars> for a formatted String.

location.description: Reduced panic location: crates/..., a dependency crate path, or <external>, then :line.

frames.description: Stack frames, innermost first. Names kept, directories removed.

module.description: The module's file name, with no directory.

offset.description: Bytes from the start of the function to the frame's address.

trail.description: The last audit events, oldest first, reduced to closed fields.

action.description: A built-in audit action constant, or other.
